newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Telemig 1997 EPS estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telemig 1997 EPS estimates raised.

text.p: Caspian Securities said it had raised its 1997 earnings estimates for Brazilian telecommunications firm Telemig to $18.20 from $15.95 per 1,000 shares.
-- the company maintained its buy rating on the stock.

-- Analysts Tony Figueiredo and Joanne Showalter said in a report they have adjusted their estimates to "reflect continued landline and cellular expansion as well as a significant one-time revenue gain from the conversion of Telemig's 355,000 rental lines into regular monthly subscriptions."
-- said Telemig's landlines grew by 18.1 percent year-on-year in the first quarter, compared with Telebras, which reported 12.1 percent landline growth over the same period.
-- "For 1997, we are assuming 15 percent year-on-year landline growth versus 12 percent for Telebras," they said.
-- Telemig preferred was up 0.5 percent at 200 reais at 1235 local time/1535 GMT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
